name: AO_Lightning
summary: This EA trades based on the Awesome Oscillator (AO) indicator, which is calculated as the difference between a fast SMA (period 34) and a slow SMA (period 5) of median prices. It opens buy positions when AO rises and sell positions when AO falls, while simultaneously closing opposite positions. The EA allows up to 10 simultaneous orders in each direction with fixed or percentage-based lot sizing.
summary_zh: 该EA基于动量震荡指标(AO)进行交易，AO由中位价的5周期SMA与34周期SMA之差计算得出。当AO上升时开多仓，当AO下降时开空仓，同时平掉反向仓位。EA允许每个方向最多10个同时持仓，支持固定手数或百分比手数。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Bill Williams的Awesome Oscillator(AO)动量指标，通过计算中位价((最高价+最低价)/2)的5周期SMA与34周期SMA的差值来判断市场动量方向。入场条件为：当AO[0]>AO[1]时（动量上升）开多仓，当AO[0]<AO[1]时（动量下降）开空仓，属于顺势动量交易策略。出场条件为：当动量方向反转时平掉所有反向仓位，即持有多仓时AO下降则平多，持有空仓时AO上升则平空。仓位管理允许每个方向最多持有Orders参数指定数量的仓位（默认10个），每次新信号触发时加仓而非重仓。资金管理支持两种模式：固定手数(LotFixed)和基于可用保证金百分比的动态手数(LotFromPercent)，并在开仓前通过OrderCalcMargin检查保证金是否充足。该策略没有设置止损和止盈，完全依赖动量反转信号来平仓，存在较大的风险敞口。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bill Williams' Awesome Oscillator (AO) momentum indicator, calculated as the difference between a 5-period SMA and a 34-period SMA of median prices ((High+Low)/2) to determine market momentum direction. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when AO[0]>AO[1] (momentum rising), and a sell position is opened when AO[0]<AO[1] (momentum falling), making this a trend-following momentum strategy. Exit conditions: all opposite-direction positions are closed when momentum reverses direction — buy positions are closed when AO declines, sell positions are closed when AO rises. Position management allows up to the 'Orders' parameter number of positions per direction (default 10), adding to positions on each new signal rather than going all-in. Money management supports two modes: fixed lot size (LotFixed) and dynamic lot sizing based on a percentage of free margin (LotFromPercent), with a pre-trade margin check via OrderCalcMargin. The strategy has no stop-loss or take-profit, relying entirely on momentum reversal signals for exits, creating significant risk exposure.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于经典的Awesome Oscillator动量指标，易于理解和验证
支持固定手数和百分比动态手数两种资金管理模式，灵活性好
开仓前有保证金检查机制，防止因资金不足导致的开仓失败
使用新K线检测机制(time_bar)避免同一根K线重复开仓，减少过度交易
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic based on the classic Awesome Oscillator momentum indicator, easy to understand and verify
Supports both fixed lot and percentage-based dynamic lot sizing, offering good flexibility
Pre-trade margin check prevents opening positions when insufficient funds are available
New bar detection mechanism (time_bar) avoids duplicate entries on the same bar, reducing overtrading
cons: 没有止损和止盈设置，完全依赖动量反转信号平仓，在剧烈行情中可能造成巨大亏损
Close函数使用while循环遍历仓位，在PositionsTotal变化时可能产生无限循环或索引错乱
卖单开仓时错误地使用了ORDER_TYPE_BUY进行保证金检查而非ORDER_TYPE_SELL
AO指标参数名称反直觉：Period_sma_slow=5实际是快速SMA，Period_sma_fast=34实际是慢速SMA
MessageBox在CheckMoneyForTrade中会阻塞EA运行，在实盘自动交易中不应使用
cons_en: No stop-loss or take-profit configured, relying entirely on momentum reversal for exits, which can cause massive losses during volatile markets
Close functions use while loops iterating over positions, which can cause infinite loops or index errors when PositionsTotal changes during iteration
Sell order margin check incorrectly uses ORDER_TYPE_BUY instead of ORDER_TYPE_SELL, potentially giving inaccurate margin calculations
AO parameter names are counterintuitive: Period_sma_slow=5 is actually the fast SMA, Period_sma_fast=34 is the slow SMA
MessageBox in CheckMoneyForTrade blocks EA execution, which is inappropriate for automated live trading
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，在市场剧烈波动时保护资金安全
修复卖单保证金检查中的ORDER_TYPE_BUY错误，应改为ORDER_TYPE_SELL
改用倒序遍历或收集待平仓ticket列表后再统一平仓，避免遍历过程中索引错乱
将MessageBox替换为Print或日志记录，避免阻塞EA自动运行
修正SMA周期参数命名，使其含义与实际用途一致
improvements_en: Add stop-loss and take-profit parameters to protect capital during extreme market volatility
Fix the ORDER_TYPE_BUY bug in sell order margin check — should use ORDER_TYPE_SELL
Use reverse iteration or collect tickets first then close in batch, avoiding index corruption during position traversal
Replace MessageBox with Print or logging to prevent blocking automated EA execution
Fix SMA period parameter naming to match their actual purpose (fast vs slow)

risk_points: 没有止损止盈，在动量持续不利时可能产生巨额浮亏
平仓函数的while循环遍历存在潜在的无限循环风险
卖单保证金检查使用了错误的方向类型，可能导致保证金计算不准确
最多允许10个同向仓位叠加，在不利行情中累积风险较大
risk_points_en: No stop-loss or take-profit can lead to massive floating losses during sustained adverse momentum
While loop in close functions poses potential infinite loop risk during position traversal
Incorrect order type in sell margin check may produce inaccurate margin calculations
Up to 10 positions in the same direction can accumulate significant risk during unfavorable moves
